title: cfd_fea_tools: guarded CFD/FEA automation with a self-classifying V&V layer

creators.name: Kahya, Kürşat

description:
An integrated OpenFOAM (CFD) and CalculiX (FEA) analysis pipeline whose distinguishing feature is a guarded, self-classifying verification-and-validation layer. Every output is assigned an uncertainty class; a non-overridable guard withholds the Grid Convergence Index outside the asymptotic range; a force-coefficient plateau criterion supersedes residual-only convergence; and a physical-plausibility bound rejects impossible force coefficients before classification.

This archive is the snapshot underlying the paper "Guarded Automation for Trustworthy CAE". It contains the source, the test suite, the evidence files behind every quantitative claim in that paper, and the scripts that regenerate them. Solver case directories are excluded as generated artefacts; each experiment script states the command that regenerates its case.
